name: ordinary-day
about: Two campaigns with leads, a month's spend and two mature cohorts beside a young one.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, 2 campaigns spent $284.25 for 7 leads at $40.61 per lead, with most leads from Regional Class A — Joliet.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet spent $184.50 for 6 leads at $30.75 per lead, with 141 clicks from 9,120 impressions and a 1.5% click rate.
Dedicated night runs spent $99.75 for 1 lead, so its cost per lead was $99.75. It had 62 clicks from 5,480 impressions and a 1.1% click rate, lower than Joliet.
Across both campaigns the day had 14,600 impressions, 203 clicks and a 1.4% click rate.
Spend so far in November 2026 is $612.30, all on Meta, with 28 days left in the month.
Of the 2026-09-28 cohort's 40 leads, 20 were made applicants (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%) and 5 were hired (12.5%). The 2026-09-21 cohort had 4 hired out of 38 leads (10.5%).
The 2026-10-26 cohort is too young to judge: so far 9 of its 12 leads have been contacted, 3 were made applicants, 1 applied and none were hired. There is no lead quality data for the last 14 days.
